post.description: DEPRECATED: ACCOUNT_DELETE & USER_PROFILE_DELETE actions are deprecated. Use DELETE /accounts/{accountId} and DELETE /users/self instead.

This endpoints serves to handle both token creation and session creation as well as session renewal.

The usage of this endpoint to login with username and password is deprecated. Instead the POST on /userlogin should be used.

If the authorization token is sent and the session is alive this information will be used. Otherwise 'name' and 'password' credentials are checked and a new session is created. Active sessions will be extended.
To request account-based authority information (as part of the JWT token response) a list of accounts can be applied.

To get more detailed information about the response token see https://jwt.io
